# Work diary — 2026-09-21 (Monday)

## Tasks due today

Carried from [19 Sep](2026-09-19.md): nothing half-done — the bridges landed and the tree was clean.

- [ ] **Level-of-detail, so the phone surface is viable again.** The scene has been knowingly
      ~10× over the phone ceiling since 19 Sep — 68,704 buildings, ~998k triangles, 18.8 MB of
      scene document, ~7 s to first frame on the laptop from the static export. Today's item.
      Starts with loading the scene as data rather than as a JS module, which the 19th's perf
      measurement pointed at.

The remaining three are written down here as the standing queue for the last three days before the
24th, in priority order. Nothing below is started today unless the item above lands early.

- [ ] **Verify the crossfade and the on-ramp in a foreground browser**, and record device load —
      the tails of [semantic zoom](../plans/2026-09-16_semantic-zoom.plan.md) and
      [schema + grey-box](../plans/2026-09-12_scene-schema-greybox.plan.md), the only items left in
      either. Blocked since 16 Sep because browser automation only ever reached a background tab,
      where `document.visibilityState` is `hidden` and `requestAnimationFrame` never fires. The 19th
      found the workaround shape: a plain Chrome tab on the static export with no debugger attached.
      Deliberately sequenced *after* the level-of-detail work — verifying frame rate on a scene
      that is ten times over budget measures the wrong thing.
- [ ] **Content — roadmap items 3 and 5.** The second 2045 scenario and the hotspot copy: the two
      items explicitly protected when semantic zoom took item 4's budget. Two scenarios is a hard
      minimum, because with one the comparison toggle is dead and the piece stops being an argument.
      Each hotspot carries its own before-and-after, since there is no "today" view to measure
      against. Includes the Thai typography pass. No engine work.
- [ ] **Exhibition hardening — roadmap item 6.** Idle reset and attract loop (the on-ramp machinery
      already does both), kiosk fullscreen, the local static export the venue-wifi fallback depends
      on, thumb-sized hit targets, QR code and short URL, ambient audio. These fail *publicly* if
      they are left to the 23rd.
- [ ] Commit the pending `.gitignore` change — `riverbanks/`, local-only studio material.
